original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Isothermal titra: The measurement of binding thermodynamics between CHIKV nsP2 and best inhibitors (LQM330, 333, 336, and 338) was executed on MicroCal ITC-200 (MicroCal®, MA, USA). For minimizing the artifacts that result from minor differences in the composition of buffers, protease and inhibitor were diluted in buffers containing 25 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 250 mM NaCl, and 4% glycerol. The samples were filtered using 0.22 μm syringe filter and then were degassed before conducting ITC experiments. The ITC calorimetric cell was loaded with purified CHIKV nsP2 at 10 μM concentration. Moreover, all these compounds at a concentration of 500 μM in the syringe was programmed to titrate into the reaction cell with one injection of 0.4 μL, followed by 13 injections of 3 μL at an interval of 180 s and at 25 °C. The stirring speed of the injector was kept at 700 rpm. ITC data was subsequently analyzed by MicroCal Origin 7.0 software from MicroCal (https://microcal-origin.software.informer.com/7.0/). Finally, the ITC data was analyzed using the one-site binding model and the binding parameters (ΔH, ΔS, and Kp values) were obtained using Malvern’s Origin 7.0 Microcal-ITC200 analysis software. All procedures are in accordance with studies previously published by our research team [15,38,39].
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Fig. 4. Binding isotherms of LQM330 (A), LQM333 (B), LQM336 (C), and LQM338 (D) with purified CHIKV nsP2PRO. The obtained ITC isotherms were fitted using the one set of sites model with the MicroCal origin 7 data analysis software and the KD value obtained for the binding of the inhibitors to CHIKV nsP2PRO. Solid lines represent the best least-squares fit to data.
original_paragraph.Table 2: Table 2 Physicochemical parameters for the binding of LQM330, LQM333, LQM336, and LQM338 into CHIKV nsP2PRO obtained by isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC). Code N Kp (μM) ΔH (cal/mol) ± SD ΔS (cal/mol/degree) LQM330 1 127 −5.70 × 10⁵ ± 4.17 × 10⁴ −1.90 × 10³ LQM333 1 159 −1.56 × 10⁵ ± 1.35 × 10⁴ −5.07 × 10² LQM336 1 198 −1.91 × 10⁵ ± 1.89 × 10⁴ −6.25 × 10² LQM338 1 218 −1.54 × 10⁵ ± 6 × 10⁴ −5.16 × 10² N: binding stoichiometry; Kp: equilibrium dissociation constant; ΔH: enthalpy variation; ΔS: entropy variation; SD: standard-deviation.
original_paragraph.Results - Isothermal titration calorimet: The thermodynamic parameters of LQM330, 333, 336, and 338 were further experimentally estimated using ITC, as well as, their Kp value (Table 2). Thus, ITC analyses demonstrated Kp values of 127, 159, 198, and 218 μM for LQM330, 333, 336, and 338, respectively. Additionally, it was verified that all these inhibitors have N value equal to 1. Furthermore, the binding of LQM330, 333, 336, and 338 to CHIKV nsP2PRO are exothermically driven, as indicated by their ΔH values, whereas these are entropically disfavored as indicated by their temperature-dependent entropy variation (TΔS). Finally, it was verified that these inhibitors present spontaneous binding modes, in which their ΔG for these reactions have negative values (ΔG < 0), being −5.69 × 10⁵, −1.56 × 10⁵, −1.90 × 10⁵, and −1.54 × 10⁵ cal/mol for LQM330, 333, 336, and 338, respectively. In Fig. 4 are shown the binding isotherms for LQM330 (A), LQM333 (B), LQM336 (C), and LQM338 (D).
